// ============================================================
// Catalog: the application shell and look - a calm back office for merchandisers.
//
// Each Acme domain is its own application: its own logo (see navigation.play), theme, accent, colour scheme and menu, on the shared
// platform (Cratis.Components + the Default blueprint's AppShell, ^1). The profile lists only the packages every Stage ships, so a screen
// built from stock components plays everywhere, Studio's Play included.
// ============================================================

theme AcmeCatalog
  compatible with Cratis.Components
  compatible with Cratis.Blueprint.Default
  compatible with PrimeReact
  compatible with Acme.Commerce

ui profile Catalog
  target platform web
  target size regular
  theme AcmeCatalog

  packages
    Cratis.Components
    Cratis.Blueprint.Default

  root template blueprint Cratis.Blueprint.Default AppShell version "^1"
    option navigationMode static
    option menuTheme light

  identity
    name "Acme Catalog"
    logo image "data:image/svg+xml;base64,"

  appearance
    color scheme light
    accent "#4338CA"
    corners default
    font inter

  sample data
    active AcmeCatalog
